# The audit's open routes (`docs/audit/7-triage.md`, "Routes and UI
# calls"): what Sonarr declares and Unarr did not, or only in part. A
# recording of its own, so the long list next door is not recorded again
# for them; same format as ../golden/requests.txt.
#
#   GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-audit/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/sonarr/golden-audit make golden

# An episode by id under the calendar and the wanted lists: the episode's
# own resource, whatever list it is on. 1 has no file, 643 has one.
calendar-1 GET /api/v3/calendar/1
calendar-643 GET /api/v3/calendar/643
calendar-missing GET /api/v3/calendar/999999
wanted-missing-1 GET /api/v3/wanted/missing/1
wanted-missing-643 GET /api/v3/wanted/missing/643
wanted-missing-missing GET /api/v3/wanted/missing/999999
wanted-cutoff-1 GET /api/v3/wanted/cutoff/1
wanted-cutoff-643 GET /api/v3/wanted/cutoff/643
wanted-cutoff-missing GET /api/v3/wanted/cutoff/999999

# The settings pages by id: the one resource, whatever the id; an id that
# is not a number matches no route.
config-host-by-id GET /api/v3/config/host/1
config-ui-by-id GET /api/v3/config/ui/1
config-downloadclient-by-id GET /api/v3/config/downloadclient/1
config-downloadclient-other-id GET /api/v3/config/downloadclient/99
config-importlist-by-id GET /api/v3/config/importlist/1
config-indexer-by-id GET /api/v3/config/indexer/1
config-mediamanagement-by-id GET /api/v3/config/mediamanagement/1
config-naming-by-id GET /api/v3/config/naming/1
config-ui-not-a-number GET /api/v3/config/ui/abc

# The dictionary by id: the same dictionary.
localization-1 GET /api/v3/localization/1
localization-999 GET /api/v3/localization/999

# The size limits of the quality definitions, not a definition.
qualitydefinition-limits GET /api/v3/qualitydefinition/limits

# Language profiles are gone since v4: one deprecated profile for any id,
# writes answered with what was sent and nothing stored.
languageprofile-999 GET /api/v3/languageprofile/999
languageprofile-schema GET /api/v3/languageprofile/schema
languageprofile-create POST /api/v3/languageprofile bodies/languageprofile.json
languageprofile-create-empty POST /api/v3/languageprofile bodies/empty-object.json
languageprofile-update PUT /api/v3/languageprofile/1 bodies/languageprofile.json
languageprofile-update-other-id PUT /api/v3/languageprofile/7 bodies/languageprofile-with-id.json
languageprofile-update-body-id PUT /api/v3/languageprofile bodies/languageprofile-with-id.json
languageprofile-update-no-id PUT /api/v3/languageprofile bodies/languageprofile.json
languageprofile-delete DELETE /api/v3/languageprofile/1
languageprofile-delete-other-id DELETE /api/v3/languageprofile/9
languageprofile-after-writes GET /api/v3/languageprofile

# An import list exclusion by id.
importlistexclusion-get-missing GET /api/v3/importlistexclusion/1
importlistexclusion-create POST /api/v3/importlistexclusion bodies/importlistexclusion-create.json
importlistexclusion-get GET /api/v3/importlistexclusion/{id:importlistexclusion-create}

# Settings > Metadata: a consumer added, tested, deleted. The bulk routes
# are declared by the base controller and hidden by Sonarr's: a 404.
metadata-1 GET /api/v3/metadata/1
metadata-create POST /api/v3/metadata bodies/metadata-create.json
metadata-created GET /api/v3/metadata/{id:metadata-create}
metadata-create-duplicate POST /api/v3/metadata bodies/metadata-create.json
metadata-create-noname POST /api/v3/metadata bodies/metadata-create-noname.json
metadata-create-unknown POST /api/v3/metadata bodies/metadata-create-unknown.json
metadata-test POST /api/v3/metadata/test bodies/metadata-test.json
metadata-test-duplicate POST /api/v3/metadata/test bodies/metadata-create.json
metadata-test-noname POST /api/v3/metadata/test bodies/metadata-create-noname.json
metadata-testall POST /api/v3/metadata/testall
metadata-action POST /api/v3/metadata/action/nothing bodies/metadata-create.json
metadata-bulk-update PUT /api/v3/metadata/bulk bodies/metadata-bulk.json
metadata-bulk-delete DELETE /api/v3/metadata/bulk bodies/metadata-bulk.json
metadata-delete DELETE /api/v3/metadata/{id:metadata-create}
metadata-delete-missing DELETE /api/v3/metadata/999999
metadata-after-delete GET /api/v3/metadata
metadata-testall-after-delete POST /api/v3/metadata/testall
